entries.name: @bsv/402-pay
entries.summary: Adds an exact-tarball Vite and esbuild contract for the browser-safe client entry point, including a bundle-size ratchet and an assertion that server exports never leak into browser consumers.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; client and server exports, payment protocol behavior, and runtime defaults are unchanged.

entries.name: @bsv/air-gap
entries.summary: Introduces the zero-dependency one-directional optical air-gap transport, wire protocol v1 (BRC-141): a versioned 23-byte header with an 8-byte session identity, exact-integer ideal-soliton fountain coding, a resource-bounded camera-safe decoder with session locking that never throws, CRC32 payload integrity, browser and Node consumers, and shared conformance vectors under conformance/vectors/transport/.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; this is the first published release of a new package with no prior public API. The experimental pre-release framing that circulated on the unmerged feature branch is not accepted by the v1 decoder.

entries.name: @bsv/amountinator
entries.summary: Adds the strict package and artifact contract and hardens amount formatting without changing the public API.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; this is a backward-compatible patch candidate.

entries.name: @bsv/auth
entries.summary: Adopts the governed strict TypeScript profile and repository-wide zero-warning lint and formatting contract.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; authentication APIs, wire behavior, and runtime defaults are unchanged.

entries.name: @bsv/auth-express-middleware
entries.summary: Contains late BRC-104 peer-processing failures after the HTTP response or connection has already settled, preventing a second Express response from terminating the service process.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; valid request, response, authentication, and error contracts are unchanged.

entries.name: @bsv/authsocket
entries.summary: Contains authentication and application callback failures to the offending socket, caps per-socket authentication concurrency, validates authenticated event envelopes, adds safe error reporting, and adds randomized and real-Socket.IO process-survival regression coverage.
entries.migration: Valid traffic and the wire contract are unchanged. A socket is now disconnected when its authentication processing exceeds the concurrency limit or a callback fails; use onError for diagnostics and maxPendingAuthMessages to tune the default limit of 32.

entries.name: @bsv/authsocket-client
entries.summary: Contains authentication and application callback failures, caps authentication concurrency, validates authenticated event envelopes, adds safe error reporting, and registers the remote payload boundary for randomized and mutation testing.
entries.migration: Valid traffic and supported imports are unchanged. The client now disconnects from a server that causes authentication failure or exceeds the concurrency limit; use onError for diagnostics and maxPendingAuthMessages to tune the default limit of 32.

entries.name: @bsv/btms
entries.summary: Adds TerraTestNet as an explicit overlay-network preset alongside the existing token-manager hardening and package contracts.
entries.migration: Existing local, mainnet, and testnet behavior is unchanged. TTN consumers select networkPreset teratestnet and use @bsv/sdk 2.4 or later.

entries.name: @bsv/btms-permission-module
entries.summary: Adopts the governed strict TypeScript profile and repository-wide zero-warning lint and formatting contract.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; permission-module APIs and token semantics are unchanged.

entries.name: @bsv/did
entries.summary: Adds an exact-tarball Vite and esbuild browser-consumer contract with public-export, source-map, server-dependency, and bundle-size ratchets.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; DID APIs, encodings, credential behavior, and supported import forms are unchanged.

entries.name: @bsv/did-client
entries.summary: Adds TerraTestNet as an explicit DID overlay-network preset and retains the governed package-quality contract.
entries.migration: Existing local, mainnet, and testnet behavior is unchanged. TTN consumers select networkPreset teratestnet and use @bsv/sdk 2.4 or later.

entries.name: @bsv/fund-wallet
entries.summary: Adopts the governed strict TypeScript profile and repository-wide zero-warning lint and formatting contract.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; wallet funding APIs and transaction behavior are unchanged.

entries.name: @bsv/gasp
entries.summary: Preserves the positional GASP constructor contract while improving declaration metadata and production maintainability, and adds an exact-tarball browser-consumer and bundle-size contract.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; existing constructor calls, imports, synchronization behavior, and wire semantics are unchanged.

entries.name: @bsv/message-box-client
entries.summary: Adds first-class TerraTestNet overlay routing while requiring an explicit TTN Message Box host until a dedicated deployment is available.
entries.migration: Existing local, mainnet, testnet, and explicit-host clients are unchanged. TTN consumers set networkPreset to teratestnet and must provide the dedicated TTN host explicitly.

entries.name: @bsv/overlay
entries.summary: Adds an engine lookup-result cardinality ceiling before transaction/proof hydration so a compact remote query cannot amplify into unbounded retained work.
entries.migration: Existing Engine constructor calls remain valid and default to 1,000 lookup formulas. Pass -1 as the final maxLookupResults argument only when a custom lookup service and deployment enforce an equivalent bound.

entries.name: @bsv/overlay-discovery-services
entries.summary: Extends WalletAdvertiser to TerraTestNet with chain-isolated SHIP/SLAP resolution and TTN wallet services.
entries.migration: Existing mainnet and testnet advertisers are unchanged. TTN operators pass chain ttn and provision the staging storage and overlay endpoints before advertising.

entries.name: @bsv/overlay-express
entries.summary: Adds a TerraTestNet runtime mode with TTN discovery roots, wallet advertising, and explicit ChainTracks requirements while retaining Arcade-first propagation.
entries.migration: Existing mainnet and testnet servers are unchanged. TTN servers call configureNetwork('ttn'), configureArcade with the TTN endpoint, and configureChaintracks or configureChainTracker before engine initialization.

entries.name: @bsv/overlay-topics
entries.summary: Adds persistent first-writer reservations for UMP presentation and recovery hashes, transfers a reservation only when the owning outpoint is consumed, exposes reservation-store integration for multi-replica overlays, and returns every matching legacy UMP candidate so wallet clients can apply verified lineage or an operator pin. It also retains the collection-index resilience and opt-in repair controls from the prior candidate.
entries.migration: Existing topic and lookup identifiers remain unchanged. Production UMP overlays must give UMPTopicManager and the UMP lookup service Mongo-backed stores that use the same database, then roll out before updated wallet clients. The reservation collection is additive and initializes from currently indexed UMP UTXOs; take a MongoDB backup before rollout. Legacy ambiguous rows remain visible and can be resolved with WAB pinning rather than deleted.

entries.name: @bsv/paymail
entries.summary: Modernizes the package contract, hardens DNS, capability discovery, and browser-compatible Paymail behavior, and shares the host application's Express runtime and types for server routers.
entries.migration: Existing Paymail client APIs and protocol semantics are retained. Consumers provide one Express 4.18 or 5 runtime and matching type graph; browser bundles continue to exclude the server router implementation.

entries.name: @bsv/payment-express-middleware
entries.summary: Standardizes package quality, strengthens payment middleware validation, edge policy, and failure handling, and shares the host application's Express runtime and types.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; legacy x-bsv-payment JSON behavior remains supported, and Express 4 and 5 applications use their own peer-provided Express installation.

entries.name: @bsv/sdk
entries.summary: Adds the teratestnet overlay preset, an isolated TTN SHIP/SLAP root, and explicit resolver selection for identity and registry clients.
entries.migration: Existing mainnet, testnet, and local routing is unchanged. TTN consumers select teratestnet explicitly because BRC-100 getNetwork continues to report testnet for all test-family chains.

entries.name: @bsv/simple
entries.summary: Adds TerraTestNet to the public Overlay configuration while retaining strict browser and server package contracts.
entries.migration: Existing overlay configurations are unchanged. TTN consumers select network teratestnet and use @bsv/sdk 2.4 or later.

entries.name: @bsv/templates
entries.summary: Consolidates MultiPushDrop script construction while preserving the exact generated locking-script sequence, adds an exact-tarball browser-consumer and bundle-size contract, and points contributors to the canonical root policy.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; template APIs, supported imports, and generated script semantics are unchanged.

entries.name: @bsv/teranode-listener
entries.summary: Refreshes the compatible libp2p transport, discovery, identification, DHT, peer-ID, ping, and private-network dependency set.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; listener APIs, topics, and network configuration are unchanged.

entries.name: @bsv/verifast
entries.summary: Adds exact-tarball browser, WASM, worker, strict-CSP, streaming-fallback, UMD source-map, and raw/gzip/Brotli bundle contracts.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; exports, verification behavior, worker protocols, package paths, and runtime defaults are unchanged.

entries.name: @bsv/wallet-helper
entries.summary: Adds strict package contracts and hardens transaction-builder and OP_RETURN validation behavior.
entries.migration: No consumer migration is required; fluent builder APIs and transaction semantics are unchanged.

entries.name: @bsv/wallet-relay
entries.summary: Adds the strict package and artifact contract, strengthens relay runtime, declaration consistency, native QR accessibility, CLI control flow, and host-owned Express type compatibility, and distinguishes generated consumer customization markers from unfinished library work.
entries.migration: QRPairingCode now renders a native button and accepts button wrapper attributes. Existing className, style, data, and ARIA props continue to work; update div-specific wrapper selectors or explicitly typed div event handlers. Express integrations now use the host application's matching Express runtime and type graph.

entries.name: @bsv/wallet-toolbox
entries.summary: Adds WAB-administered UMP ambiguity pinning, verified same-or-new phone-number changes that roll the presentation key by spending the current UMP token, and retry-safe WAB commit semantics, alongside the local-first ChainTracks management, proof-of-work enforcement, bounded validation, cache, and observability candidate.
entries.migration: Existing authentication calls remain compatible. WAB operators should deploy the additive auth response and phone-change endpoints before exposing client UI. Wallet applications that offer phone changes call startPhoneNumberChange, collect the SMS code, call completePhoneNumberChange, and persist saveSnapshot immediately after success. A pin is considered only when normal verified lineage resolution remains ambiguous and only when it names a verified lookup candidate.

entries.name: @bsv/wallet-toolbox-client
entries.summary: Carries the browser-safe WAB UMP-pin fallback and verified phone-number/presentation-key rotation APIs together with the local-first ChainTracks controller, proof-of-work enforcement, bounded fetch and inline validation, checkpoint cache, download-budget contracts, and lockstep Wallet Toolbox corrections.
entries.migration: Existing browser exports, defaults, and authentication calls remain compatible. A settings UI may call startPhoneNumberChange and completePhoneNumberChange, including with the currently registered number, and must save the returned manager snapshot after success. Deploy compatible WAB and UMP overlay services first.

entries.name: @bsv/wallet-toolbox-mobile
entries.summary: Carries the mobile-safe WAB UMP-pin fallback and verified phone-number/presentation-key rotation APIs together with the local-first ChainTracks controller, proof-of-work enforcement, bounded fetch and inline validation, checkpoint cache, download-budget contracts, and lockstep Wallet Toolbox corrections.
entries.migration: Existing React Native exports, remote-storage behavior, and authentication calls remain compatible. A settings UI may call startPhoneNumberChange and completePhoneNumberChange, including with the currently registered number, and must persist saveSnapshot after success. Deploy compatible WAB and UMP overlay services first.

entries.name: create-bsv-app
entries.summary: Adds TTN to the CLI, browser configurator, configuration model, and persisted project-manifest network choices.
entries.migration: Existing mainnet and testnet scaffolds are unchanged. New TTN projects pass --network ttn or select TerraTestNet in the configurator.
